lines: 1 shipped package is under GPL-2.0-only, which cannot be combined with AGPL-3.0-or-later, the licence of the app:
GPL-2.0-only puts its terms on the whole work and allows no later GPL version, so it goes neither with a permissive app nor with GPL-3.0, AGPL-3.0, LGPL-3.0 or Apache-2.0.
A bundle is one work under one licence: replace the package, or take it under another licence it is offered under.
1 shipped package is under "CC-BY-3.0", a licence licences.json gives no verdict on:
